description: Pack files into a .pcc archive (the lab's zip). Each file is compressed with the hosted engine; returns the archive as base64 plus packed size and member count. Read-only computation — nothing is stored. Use to bundle multiple files; use spl_compress for a single blob, spl_unzip to restore.

files.description: Files to pack. Each item: path (archive path), data_b64 (base64 file bytes; omit for directories), dir (true for a directory entry).

data_b64.description: Base64-encoded file bytes. Omit for directory entries.

dir.description: True when this entry is a directory (no bytes). Defaults to false.

path.description: Path inside the archive, e.g. notes/readme.txt.

name: spl_zip
